definitions.explanation: A paper voucher issued by a local municipality that entitles a resident to receive a specific vaccination, typically free of charge or at a subsidized rate.

examples.japanese: {接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
{接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please bring your vaccination voucher to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}して→再発行する：21951_saihakkousuru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you move, you need to have a new vaccination voucher reissued by your new municipality.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{接種|せっしゅ}→接種：22649_sesshu⟧ (vaccination, inoculation) and ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket, voucher). This term became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic when Japan distributed vaccination vouchers to all residents through their registered municipalities.

The voucher system reflects Japan's municipal-based healthcare administration. Vouchers are typically mailed to residents and contain a barcode or number linked to the person's vaccination records. They are used for flu shots, childhood immunizations, and other public health campaigns as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a vaccination voucher
- {接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}する→再発行する：21951_saihakkousuru⟧: to reissue a vaccination voucher
- {接種券|せっしゅけん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予診票|よしんひょう}→予診票：30034_yoshinhyou⟧: pre-examination questionnaire with voucher attached

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予診票|よしんひょう}→予診票：30034_yoshinhyou⟧: pre-vaccination questionnaire — filled out before receiving a shot
- ⟦{接種|せっしゅ}→接種：22649_sesshu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: vaccination certificate — proof of vaccination
- ⟦{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧: preventive vaccination — the general term for immunization
